cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/work')
import compiler
from harness import check_plan

# complete graph on 8 participants
N = 8
links = [(u, v) for u in range(8) for v in range(u + 1, 8)]
random.seed(3)
demands = {v: random.randrange(1, 10) for v in range(8)}
envelope = {i: 20 for i in range(len(links))}
period = 2
caps = {l: period * r for l, r in envelope.items()}
cut, deficit = compiler.find_deficient_cut(N, links, caps, range(8), demands)
print('deficit', deficit)
t0 = time.time()
plan = compiler._try_variant(N, links, envelope, period, range(8), demands, 'relay')
print('relay', 'plan' if plan else None, '%.3fs' % (time.time() - t0))
ok, why = check_plan(plan, N, links, caps, range(8), demands, period, envelope)
print('valid', ok, why, 'routes', len(plan['routes']), 'recipes', len(plan['recipes']))
loads = compiler._plan_loads(plan, links)
print('max load', max(loads.values()), 'cap', period * 20)

# 32 participants, complete-ish mesh via ordinary hubs: 16 hubs, each participant
# attached to all hubs would be 512 links - too many. use 8 hubs x 32 participants
N = 40
PARTS = list(range(32))
ORD = list(range(32, 40))
links = []; seen = set()
def add(u, v):
    key = (min(u, v), max(u, v))
    if key in seen or u == v: return
    seen.add(key); links.append((u, v))
for i in range(len(ORD)):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(ORD)):
        add(ORD[i], ORD[j])
for p in PARTS:
    for k in range(3):
        add(p, ORD[(p * (k + 1)) % len(ORD)])
print('links', len(links))
demands = {p: random.randrange(1, 6) for p in PARTS}
envelope = {i: 30 for i in range(len(links))}
period = 3
caps = {l: period * r for l, r in envelope.items()}
cut, deficit = compiler.find_deficient_cut(N, links, caps, PARTS, demands)
print('deficit', deficit)
t0 = time.time()
plan = compiler._try_variant(N, links, envelope, period, PARTS, demands, 'relay')
print('relay', 'plan' if plan else None, '%.3fs' % (time.time() - t0))
if plan:
    ok, why = check_plan(plan, N, links, caps, PARTS, demands, period, envelope)
    print('valid', ok, why, 'routes', len(plan['routes']), 'recipes', len(plan['recipes']))
    loads = compiler._plan_loads(plan, links)
    print('max load', max(loads.values()), 'cap', period * 30)
PYEOF
